 Can't-Miss Play: 64-yard TD! Shedeur Sanders and KC Concepcion stun Saints in fourth quarter
 Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders tosses a 64-yard pass to wide receiver KC Concepcion who scores his first career NFL touchdown to take the lead over the New Orleans Saints.

 Cleveland Browns tight end Harold Fannin Jr. uses a stiff arm and scores on a 39-yard touchdown to answer the New Orleans Saints score in overtime.
 NOW PLAYING video Andre Szmyt drills clutch 51-yard FG to tie game vs. Saints
 Cleveland Browns kicker Andre Szmyt ties the game against the New Orleans Saints with a 51-yard field goal in the final seconds of regulation.
 NOW PLAYING video Can't-Miss Play: Shedeur absorbs HUGE hit from Chase Young while delivering 30-yard dime to Jeudy
 Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders completes a tough pass while absorbing contact against the New Orleans Saints and finds wide receiver Jerry Jeudy for a 30-yard gain.
 NOW PLAYING video Myles Harden blitzes untouched for first career sack
 The Cleveland Browns dial up the cornerback blitz as Myles Harden takes down New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough untouched to record his first career NFL sack.
 NOW PLAYING video Carson Schwesinger's second sack of day results in 2-yard loss for Shough
 Cleveland Browns linebacker Carson Schwesinger records his second sack of the game, taking down New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough for a 2-yard loss.
 NOW PLAYING video Andre Szmyt puts Browns ahead 6-3 on 30-yard FG vs. Saints
